decisions.statement: The quest catalog arrives as an argument rather than as an imported table.
A quest a companion gives is left out of the zone reckoning.
A zone whose every quest belongs to a companion is left out.
The companion reckoning takes the quests from the companion quest module.
A character read only for roster fields is skipped.
An empty catalog answers an empty list.

definition: how many quests a character has finished, zone by zone and companion by companion
